name: Poring
summary: A gentle pink jelly that travels by bouncing and swallows stray belongings, making it a familiar companion to beginner adventures.

name: Familiar
summary: Colonies of these cave bats feed with sharp teeth and pursue intruders with relentless, rapid attacks.

name: Fabre
summary: This round grassland larva begins the life cycle that passes through Pupa before becoming a Creamy.

name: Pupa
summary: A tough cocoon shelters the next stage of Fabre's life; the creature inside will eventually emerge as a Creamy.

name: Condor
summary: An aging desert scavenger survives on remains and travelers' scraps. Disturbing one can bring the surrounding flock down upon an intruder.

name: Willow
summary: An old tree animated by troubled fairy magic, remembered for its eerie shape and unsettling sounds.

name: Chonchon
summary: A widespread, fast-moving fly whose discarded wings are associated with the teleportation items carried by travelers.

name: Roda Frog
summary: A mutated amphibian of damp grasslands and forests, often found close to water and announced by its persistent croaking.

name: Wolf
summary: These blue-maned hunters usually avoid people, but threatening one can provoke the rest of its pack.

name: Spore
summary: A plump, mobile mushroom whose swaying movements attract attention in forests and underground passages.

name: Zombie
summary: Dark shamanic magic has returned this corpse to motion. Its poisonous breath makes the walking dead especially unwelcome company.

name: Archer Skeleton
summary: A cursed marksman of sunless places, retaining a disturbingly accurate aim despite the loss of living eyes.

name: Creamy
summary: The winged adult of the Fabre life cycle feeds through a curled mouthpart and is known for escaping danger by teleportation.

name: Mandragora
summary: This rooted plant reaches unsuspecting travelers with stalks concealed beneath the ground, making distance an unreliable protection.

name: Orc Warrior
summary: A forest-dwelling fighter from the Orcs' own society, known for intimidating travelers and demanding their possessions.

name: Boa
summary: A green snake of woodland and desert country. Its lack of venom does not make an encounter entirely harmless.

name: Munak
summary: Resentment binds this young woman's remains to the living world. The old accounts connect her fate with Bongun.

name: Soldier Skeleton
summary: A restless soldier of dark passages, still carrying a sword in each hand long after flesh and purpose have vanished.

name: Isis
summary: Accounts describe a royal attendant reborn as a serpent-woman, remaining devoted to the king's tomb and hostile to its intruders.

name: Poporing
summary: A swamp-adapted relative of Poring whose elastic green body carries poison beneath its deceptively familiar bounce.

name: Verit
summary: This mummified dog continues gathering dropped objects for its master, preserving a strangely cheerful loyalty beyond death.

name: Elder Willow
summary: An ancient Willow inhabited by a fairy, with magical power attributed to the many years it has endured.

name: Thara Frog
summary: A red, more formidable relative of Roda Frog that favors dark, wet places and shares its noisy croak.

name: Hunter Fly
summary: A crimson relative of Chonchon, infamous for its speed and deadly pursuit of unwary travelers.

name: Ghoul
summary: An unsatisfied corpse-eater raised by a shaman's curse, unable to content itself with the dead and drawn toward the living.

name: Side Winder
summary: Stories sometimes give it two heads, but this snake confuses enemies with coordinated movements of its head and blunt tail.

name: Osiris
summary: An ancient ruler once revered as a sun deity, now remembered as a powerful undead lord associated with the Sphinx.

name: Baphomet
summary: A notorious, scythe-bearing demon whose offspring roam Midgard. Accounts describe the forest incarnation as only a portion of its full power.

name: Golem
summary: Ancient magic gave motion to stone. The weight of its enchanted body explains the slow, deliberate movement of this construct.

name: Mummy
summary: A bandaged remnant of Morocc's pyramids, sometimes accompanied by the faithful undead dog Verit.

name: Steel Chonchon
summary: A yellow-green Chonchon protected by a hard shell, with a habit of collecting whatever travelers leave on the ground.

name: Obeaune
summary: A fierce mermaid whose wild hair is itself a weapon, defending her underwater territory from unwelcome visitors.

name: Marc
summary: A proud-looking deep-sea creature resembling a seahorse, protected by exceptionally firm skin and a dragonlike silhouette.

name: Doppelganger
summary: A demon that borrows a living person's appearance, using an adventurer's own likeness to approach and betray its victim.

name: Thief Bug Egg
summary: Several young Thief Bugs may emerge from this egg, continuing the infestation of damp and neglected places.

name: Picky
summary: A young Peco Peco that grows quickly while hunting small insects across the desert.

name: Thief Bug
summary: A quick-moving scavenger of dark, damp places, notorious for carrying away unattended belongings and gathering in swarms.

name: Rocker
summary: A romantic grasshopper musician wanders with a violin and leaf parasol, adding a rather noisy soundtrack to the grasslands.

name: Muka
summary: A desert cactus with an alarming voice, retaliating against attackers with needles and stored cactus water.

name: Smokie
summary: A woodland raccoon associated with a magical leaf, said to disguise itself and vanish from sight when threatened.

name: Yoyo
summary: A clever, banana-loving forest monkey that delights in troubling travelers and cooperates readily with its companions.

name: Metaller
summary: A brown desert relative of Rocker, adapted to harsher ground and quick to collect discarded items.

name: Mistress
summary: The elusive queen of the bees directs her workers with the honey pot she carries.

name: Bigfoot
summary: Despite its misleading name, this creature is a large, solitary bear, fond of sleep and easily angered by disturbance.

name: Nightmare
summary: A spectral horse linked with the journey of the dead to Hel, surrounded by ominous smoke and otherworldly fire.

name: Lunatic
summary: A shaggy, rabbit-shaped creature with a fondness for carrots and an exceptionally soft coat.

name: Strouf
summary: A lord among the merfolk, carrying a trident associated with lightning against visitors from the surface.

name: Vadon
summary: A coastal crustacean whose thick armor and powerful pincers are more memorable than its resemblance to an ordinary crab.

name: Cornutus
summary: A mild sea creature near Izlude that withdraws into a heavy, turban-shaped shell.

name: Hydra
summary: An aquatic plant whose hidden roots and reaching tentacles threaten creatures well beyond its small visible body.

name: Swordfish
summary: A sea hunter distinguished by its blade-like snout, with old accounts also attributing ultrasonic attacks to it.

name: Kukre
summary: A swift beach scavenger that consumes dropped objects, sharing the Thief Bug's appetite without its usual group aggression.

name: Pirate Skeleton
summary: The remains of a pirate lost at sea, still wearing a bandana and wandering as though the old voyage never ended.

name: Kaho
summary: A flame-wreathed lesser demon from another world, fond of dramatic appearances and showy attacks.

name: Crab
summary: A familiar coastal creature whose hard shell is its most notable protection.

name: Shellfish
summary: A small marine creature that moves about on a pair of tiny legs.

name: Skeleton
summary: A person's lingering resentment has outlived the flesh, leaving animated bones hostile to the living.

name: Poison Spore
summary: A venomous, dark-capped Spore whose movements can fool travelers into mistaking it for its gentler relative.

name: Golden Thief Bug
summary: A rare Thief Bug distinguished by a larger body and a brilliantly golden shell.

name: Orc Hero
summary: A celebrated commander from the Orcs' war with humanity, whose swordsmanship is surrounded by tales of thunder.

name: Vocal
summary: An admired leader among Rockers, blessed with a pleasing voice but willing to turn its violin into a weapon.

name: Toad
summary: A giant frog that travels with Roda Frogs and boldly challenges creatures of comparable size.

name: Mastering
summary: An unusually large Poring that gathers ordinary Porings around it, lending substance to its commanding name.

name: Dragon Fly
summary: A rare leader among Chonchons, named for exaggerated tales comparing its strength with that of a dragon.

name: Vagabond Wolf
summary: A wolf that survived separation from its original pack and now leads other wolves in search of a living.

name: Eclipse
summary: A large, unusually hostile Lunatic that rallies its smaller kin against intruders.

name: Andre
summary: A diligent worker ant serving Queen Maya, gathering supplies for the colony and relying on nearby workers for support.

name: Angeling
summary: A powerful Poring form whose hostility is linked in old accounts to witnessing the mistreatment of its kin.

name: Ant Egg
summary: A cluster containing the next generation of the colony; Andre, Piere, or Deniro may emerge when it hatches.

name: Anubis
summary: A guardian associated with the Sphinx, standing among the desert's ancient supernatural defenders.

name: Argiope
summary: A huge, segmented arthropod that threatens passersby with venomous fangs.

name: Argos
summary: An enormous spider whose size makes the ordinary solution to a household pest decidedly impractical.

name: Bathory
summary: A demon-serving witch who travels by broom and attacks through a crystal ball, despite a fondness for girlish ornaments.

name: Caramel
summary: A timid porcupine whose gentle appearance changes quickly when someone touches its spines.

name: Coco
summary: A small, swift squirrel usually seen carrying an acorn, with an expression that makes it seem perpetually displeased.

name: Deniro
summary: A red worker ant that scavenges supplies and cooperates with the rest of its colony when threatened.

name: Desert Wolf
summary: A robust desert hunter that relies on strong jaws and swift legs, with companions ready to join a fight.

name: Deviace
summary: An unusual sea creature that lures prey with an antenna and catches it in a remarkably large mouth.

name: Deviruchi
summary: A young demon that has yet to master magic, relying instead on a surprisingly dangerous little pitchfork.

name: Dokebi
summary: A mischievous creature of Korean tradition, associated with riddles, wealth, and encounters with travelers near Payon.
